notes: Studio is now its own tab: type an idea such as "calm and slow" or "a bright waltz, 2 minutes" and the tablet writes a piece, showing each step, the notes as they are written and the time left. Every piece gets a cover drawn from its music and joins the new Made in Studio playlist; "another like it", "slower" or "longer" change the last one. On Now playing, drag the divider between the sheet music and the notes to resize them or hide one, and a View button holds the note style, fingering, chord names and hand colours. The Piano tab is reorganised into Instruments, The piano, Playing, Sharing and This tablet, with a search box that finds any setting by name.
